name: Boys & Girls Club of Greater Salem Summer Camp
operator_name: Boys & Girls Club of Greater Salem
description_short: Day camp at the Boys & Girls Club in Salem, NH, for kids from kindergarten up, grouped by the grade they are entering, with a separate teen group. Campers rotate through the Club's program areas, outdoor courts and pool, and go on a field trip each week.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers use the Club's pool. Send a swimsuit and towel every day.

source.title: Boys & Girls Club of Greater Salem
